story: Parts arrive at a steady rate and pass along a line of four stations. Each part is a pixel on the picture below.
note: The times are illustrative, chosen for the picture. Each station can work on any number of parts at once.

treatments.label: Jam the painting booth door
treatments.because: Parts finish painting but cannot leave the booth, so they wait there while later parts keep arriving behind them.

treatments.label: Run the welder at half speed
treatments.because: Each part spends twice as long at the welder, so more parts are in it at any moment.

treatments.label: Scrap faulty parts at the painting booth
treatments.because: A share of the parts in the booth is removed every minute, so fewer reach packing.
